Usage: svg [--help] [--output] [--theme] [--black-and-white] [--exclude-drawing-sheet] [--no-background-color] input

Positional arguments:
  input                    Input file

Optional arguments:
  -h, --help               shows help message and exits
  -o, --output             Output directory:
  -t, --theme              Color theme to use (will default to pcbnew settings)
  --black-and-white        Black and white only
  --exclude-drawing-sheet  No drawing sheet
  --no-background-color    Avoid setting a background color (regardless of theme)
